description: This file defines the TransfersProvider class, which manages local transfer records in a Flutter application. It handles loading, reloading, and submitting transfer data, interacting with a transfers repository and notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: TransfersProvider
classes.description: A provider class for managing transfer data locally, suitable for demo purposes. It extends ChangeNotifier to provide reactive updates to the UI.

methods.name: TransfersProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the provider with a repository.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loads initial data from the repository, and returns the provider instance.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Getter that returns the current loading state.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads transfers data from the repository, updating the loading state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Creates a new transfer instance, adds it to the repository, reloads data, and returns the created transfer.
